description: Explicit Phase 4 review registry for legacy data queries that are safe because their caller, ownership join, transaction context, or controlled maintenance context provides the company boundary.

reviews.reason: Report shard receives the already-authorized company context from the chat report orchestrator.
Report shard receives the already-authorized company context from the chat report orchestrator.
PDF generation is called after the owning invoice or voucher has been company-authorized.
Startup repair queries run in controlled migration context, not from caller-supplied request identity.
Inventory mutations are invoked inside company-scoped transactional write paths.
Ledger IDs are resolved from the already company-scoped allocation flow.
Account and voucher ownership is validated before the pagination query executes.
Account and voucher ownership is validated before the transaction query executes.
Administrative cleanup operates only on records selected by the company-scoped orphan scan.
Repair targets are selected through the company-scoped administrative repair flow.
Repair targets are produced by the company-scoped dry-run token and apply flow.
Undo targets are validated by the company-scoped repair audit before mutation.
Bank and fixed-asset queries use the active company boundary before loading entries.
Tracking routes validate container ownership before loading tracking records.
Container-number maintenance runs after the container ownership guard.
Factory employee recalculation is pinned to the active factory company.
Factory employee financial writes run inside the active factory company scope.
Planner queries carry the active factory company through their route-owned transaction.
Shipping-container rows are reached through the factory company boundary and parent ownership.
Revision writes are protected by the migrated-voucher company guard.
Git reporting loads only resources selected by the active company context.
Payroll accounting helpers receive the active factory company from their route caller.
Payroll migration maintenance is explicitly company-selected and guarded before execution.
Rental accrual writes use the active company rental scope.
Rental guarantee queries are reached through the active company rental scope.
Supplier Partner migration helpers use the exact source/target company pair supplied by the migration guard.
Supplier Partner migration runs require the source/target company authorization boundary.
Supplier Partner migration sales use the authorized source/target company pair.
Cutover readiness is computed only for the authorized Supplier Partner company pair.
Supplier Partner charge migration uses the authorized source/target company pair.
Sales report queries use the active company reporting boundary.
Bulk stock operations validate the active company before loading item rows.
Stock-item management validates item ownership in the active company.
Transfer and adjustment writes run inside the active company inventory transaction.
Bulk entry deletion is guarded by the owning voucher company boundary.
Tracking service receives company-authorized container IDs from its route caller.
Tracking service receives company-authorized container IDs from its route caller.
Tracking persistence receives company-authorized container IDs from its service caller.
Scheduled tracking selects containers through the company-scoped scheduler context.
Immediate tracking receives company-authorized container IDs from its caller.
Single-container tracking receives a company-authorized container ID.
Offload lifecycle writes run in the company-scoped inventory transaction.
Factory reconciliation receives the active factory company from the offload transaction.
POS sale item construction runs inside the assigned POS company transaction.
POS inventory deduction runs inside the assigned POS company transaction.
Maintenance jobs select their company scope before running data repairs.
Startup orphan repair is controlled maintenance, not caller-driven data access.
Startup schema maintenance is controlled and idempotent, not caller-driven data access.
Startup migrations and one-time repairs run in controlled process-level maintenance context across all companies, outside request handling and without caller-supplied tenant identity.
Startup stock_items schema repair reads column names from information_schema and issues ADD COLUMN DDL under the explicit maintenance capability; it never reads or writes a stock_items row.
Voucher storage writes execute inside the caller's company-scoped transaction.
Voucher storage reads are reached after the owning company scope is established.

Single SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inventory lock shared by the stock-transfer, adjustment, cost-price and container-offload writes. It is only ever called with a transaction handle from inside those company-scoped write transactions, which resolve the location and stock item under the active company before locking the row.
Transfer and adjustment updates lock inventory inside the company-scoped transaction.
